suite: SAAMX Consolidated Build Phase 2 — Physical Bank Desk and Two-Phase Settlement

results.title: Pre-flight Authoritative State Hash Verification
results.scenario: Verify state.json SHA-256 matches immutable baseline

results.title: Session Token Acquisition for Bank Desk Roles
results.scenario: Acquire JWT/HMAC session tokens for all operational roles including bank_teller
results.expected: HTTP 200 with valid session tokens for bank_teller, admin, sebi, and participant teams
results.actual: bank: role=bank_teller, admin: role=admin, T01: role=team

results.title: Settlement Mode Configuration RBAC Enforcement
results.scenario: Unauthorized participant team attempts to change settlement mode
results.expected: HTTP 403 Forbidden

results.title: Settlement Mode Validation (Invalid Mode Rejection)
results.scenario: Administrator attempts to set an invalid settlement mode
results.expected: HTTP 400 Bad Request with supported modes message

evidence.error: Invalid settlement mode. Supported modes are 'INSTANT' and 'TWO_PHASE_BANK'.

results.title: Admin Sets Settlement Mode to INSTANT
results.scenario: Administrator sets settlementMode to INSTANT
results.expected: HTTP 200 with settlementMode: INSTANT

evidence.message: Settlement mode successfully updated to INSTANT.

results.title: INSTANT Mode Backwards Compatibility
results.scenario: Execute BUY order in INSTANT mode; verify immediate debit/credit and no pending voucher
results.expected: orderStatus: EXECUTED, settlementStatus: SETTLED, no pending bank vouchers created

results.title: TWO_PHASE_BANK Buy Execution & Cash Reservation
results.scenario: Execute BUY in TWO_PHASE_BANK mode; verify EXECUTED_PENDING_SETTLEMENT, cash reserved not debited, holdings not credited yet
results.expected: Order EXECUTED_PENDING_SETTLEMENT, cashWallets.INR unchanged, reservedCash increased by totalValue, holdings unchanged, pending voucher created
results.actual: orderStatus: EXECUTED_PENDING_SETTLEMENT, cashWallets.INR: 993847.6 (pre: 993847.6), reservedCash.INR: 12304.8 (pre: 0), holdings.TCS: 110 (pre: 110), voucher: SETTLE_1793410838166_R4MK

results.title: Double-Spend & Purchasing Power Protection
results.scenario: Attempt order exceeding unreserved cash balance (cash minus reservedCash)
results.expected: HTTP 400 rejection stating Insufficient unreserved INR balance with reservation notice
results.actual: VALIDATE HTTP 400: "Insufficient unreserved INR balance. Required: ₹9,91,766.88, Available: ₹9,81,542.80 (₹12,304.80 reserved for pending settlement).", EXECUTE HTTP 400: "Insufficient unreserved INR balance. Required: ₹9,91,766.88, available: ₹9,81,542.80 (₹12,304.80 reserved for pending settlement)."

evidence.validateError: Insufficient unreserved INR balance. Required: ₹9,91,766.88, Available: ₹9,81,542.80 (₹12,304.80 reserved for pending settlement).
evidence.execError: Insufficient unreserved INR balance. Required: ₹9,91,766.88, available: ₹9,81,542.80 (₹12,304.80 reserved for pending settlement).

results.title: TWO_PHASE_BANK Sell Execution & Proceeds Locking
results.scenario: Execute SELL in TWO_PHASE_BANK; verify shares surrendered immediately but cash proceeds uncredited
results.expected: Order EXECUTED_PENDING_SETTLEMENT, holdings reduced immediately, cashWallets unchanged (unspendable), voucher PROCEEDS_DISBURSEMENT created
results.actual: orderStatus: EXECUTED_PENDING_SETTLEMENT, holdings.INFY: 75 (pre: 100), cashWallets.INR: 993847.6 (pre: 993847.6), voucher: SETTLE_1793410838626_LJUO

results.title: Bank Teller Settlement Confirmation (Payment Collection / Buy)
results.scenario: Bank teller confirms BUY payment collection voucher; cash debited, reservation released, holdings credited
results.expected: HTTP 200, settlement SETTLED, order SETTLED, reservedCash reduced, cashWallet debited, holdings credited
results.actual: HTTP 200, settlementStatus: SETTLED, orderStatus: SETTLED, reservedCash.INR: 0, holdings.TCS: 130

results.title: Bank Teller Settlement Confirmation (Proceeds Disbursement / Sell)
results.scenario: Bank teller confirms SELL proceeds disbursement voucher; cash credited to team wallet
results.expected: HTTP 200, settlement SETTLED, order SETTLED, cashWallets.INR credited with totalAmount
results.actual: HTTP 200, settlementStatus: SETTLED, orderStatus: SETTLED, cashWallets.INR: 1020673.55

results.title: Duplicate Settlement Attempt Rejection (409 Conflict)
results.scenario: Attempt second settlement call on already SETTLED voucher
results.expected: HTTP 409 Conflict with duplicate settlement notice; zero ledger modification
results.actual: HTTP 409: "Duplicate settlement prevented: This voucher has already been settled and funds processed.", cashWallets.INR unchanged at 1020673.55

evidence.error: Duplicate settlement prevented: This voucher has already been settled and funds processed.

results.title: Settlement Rejection for Buy Voucher (Cash Reservation Release)
results.scenario: Bank teller rejects BUY voucher; verify reason enforced, reservation released, float returned
results.expected: Empty reason 400; valid reason 200; settlement REJECTED, order SETTLEMENT_REJECTED, reservedCash restored, float units restored
results.actual: noReason: HTTP 400, validReject: HTTP 200, reservedCash.INR: 0 (was 9228.6), float: 12834138 (was 12834123)

results.title: Settlement Rejection for Sell Voucher (Holdings Restoration)
results.scenario: Bank teller rejects SELL voucher; verify surrendered shares returned to team holdings
results.expected: HTTP 200, settlement REJECTED, order SETTLEMENT_REJECTED, holdings restored

results.title: Anonymous Access Blocked on /api/bank/settlements
results.scenario: Unauthenticated caller attempts to query bank settlements list
results.expected: HTTP 401 Unauthorized

results.title: Team Settlement List Scoping & Privacy
results.scenario: Team T01 queries settlements; must only see T01 records, T02 strictly excluded
results.expected: HTTP 200, array containing only T01 records, 0 records for T02

results.title: Cross-Team Individual Voucher Inspection Blocked
results.scenario: Team T01 attempts to inspect settlement voucher belonging to T02
results.expected: HTTP 403 Forbidden

evidence.error: Forbidden: You cannot access settlement records belonging to another team.

results.title: Participant Team Prohibited from Self-Settling
results.scenario: Student participant team attempts to confirm settlement on a voucher
results.expected: HTTP 403 Forbidden

evidence.error: Forbidden: Processing bank settlements requires Bank Teller or Administrator privileges.

results.title: Participant Team Prohibited from Rejecting Settlements
results.scenario: Participant team attempts to call settlement rejection endpoint
results.expected: HTTP 403 Forbidden

evidence.error: Forbidden: Processing bank settlements requires Bank Teller or Administrator privileges.

results.title: Native USD Currency Wallet Accuracy & Reservation Release
results.scenario: Settle USD trade voucher for OAI; verify cashWallets.USD debited, reservedCash.USD released, INR wallet unchanged
results.expected: cashWallets.USD debited by 900 USD, reservedCash.USD reduced to 0, INR wallet strictly untouched

results.title: Transaction Void of Pending Two-Phase Trade
results.scenario: Void transaction with linked pending bank voucher; verify reservedCash released without double-crediting cashWallets
results.expected: HTTP 200, transaction voided, settlement VOIDED, order VOIDED, reservedCash released, cashWallets unchanged
results.actual: HTTP 200, settlementStatus: VOIDED, orderStatus: VOIDED, reservedCash: 0 (was 7382.88), cashWallets: 1020673.55 (was 1020673.55)

results.title: Anonymous Access Blocked on /api/bank/reconciliation
results.scenario: Unauthenticated caller attempts to access bank reconciliation report
results.expected: HTTP 401 Unauthorized

results.title: Participant Team Blocked from /api/bank/reconciliation
results.scenario: Participant team attempts to access supervisory bank reconciliation report
results.expected: HTTP 403 Forbidden

evidence.error: Forbidden: Bank reconciliation requires Bank Desk or Regulatory privileges.

results.title: Bank Reconciliation Report Accuracy & Health Check
results.scenario: Bank teller queries reconciliation audit summary and discrepancy check
results.expected: HTTP 200, status: HEALTHY, discrepancies: [], accurate summary counts and currency breakdown
results.actual: HTTP 200, status: HEALTHY, totalSettlements: 6, settledCount: 3, discrepancies: 0

results.title: Bank Desk UI Route & Navigation Registration Audit
results.scenario: Verify BankPage component exists, registered in App.jsx routing and navigationConfig.js
results.expected: BankPage.jsx exists, navigation item registered for bank_teller/admin/sebi/team, route case #/bank in App.jsx
results.actual: BankPage exists: true, navConfig registered: true, App.jsx routing registered: true

results.title: Post-flight Authoritative State Hash Verification
results.scenario: Confirm authoritative state.json was completely protected from mutations
